column1: # Held sentences (T221, en): never tuned on; the same lines as cases-en.tsv.

= It's a real honour to be entrusted with this role and I'm excited about the future | I'm happy to be here and I'll be even happier when we get down to business and start working with the group | It's a challenging environment but one I really wanted to work in | If we all work together, and if we're patient, we can enjoy a long and fruitful relationship | I don't wish to discuss this
I look forward to the future
glad to be here, eager to start working
tough job but I wanted it

= I believe so; the playing staff here fit my philosophy and that's a big part of why I came here | I really believe in my system, but it requires a certain type of player, which is the kind of player I want to bring in to the side | I've always enjoyed that style of football but, at the end of the day, my job is to get the best out of the players | Every group of players brings a different set of strengths and weaknesses for a manager, so I'm looking forward to finding the system that suits them best | To be honest, I think this has all been overstated in the media. The results come first and I plan to set the team up to get them
I'll bring in the right type of player
getting the best out of the players is what matters
I'll find the right system for them

= At the end of the day I think it probably was, FC Den Bosch had to make a decision they felt was best for the club | I can certainly see why they decided to take a different approach, and I bear no grudges | I don't think it's appropriate to discuss that, I've moved on and want to focus on my new job | I think it was a bit harsh looking back | I think I was treated extremely unfairly and the decision was absolutely the wrong one
it was the best decision for the club
not appropriate to discuss, I've moved on

= I think it was imperative to, football is my life and I'd hate to be out of the game for too long | I'm very pleased to have landed on my feet, so to speak. | I don't think it's appropriate to discuss that, I've moved on and want to focus on my new job | I think it was a case of being in the right place at the right time, and thankfully Helmond Sport were keen to talk to me | I could hardly say no to a club like this
I love football too much to be away
how could I refuse this club

= I can honestly say there were no problems at any stage. This is meant to be | I knew I had to jump at the chance if it came my way and I'm very lucky it did | Not particularly, although I'm not naive enough to think there won't be rough times to go along with the smooth, as there are in any job | I know I've had a lot of faith put in me and I have to make sure I repay that faith each and every day | I'd say they were more questions than reservations, but I know the challenges of the job, and I'm looking forward to tackling them
I need to repay the faith
